opis: Vesoljec Harry, ki je strmoglavil na Zemlji, prevzame identiteto zdravnika v majhnem mestu v Koloradu in se počasi pričenja boriti z moralno dilemo glede svoje skrivne misije na Zemlji.
reziser: Robert Duncan McNeill, Lea Thompson, Jay Chandrasekhar
igralci: Alan Tudyk (Harry Vanderspeigle), Sara Tomko (Asta Twelvetrees), Corey Reynolds (Sheriff Mike Thompson), Alice Wetterlund (DArcy Bloom), Alice Wetterlund (Darcy Bloom), Levi Fiehler (Mayor Ben Hawthorne), Elizabeth Bowen (Deputy Liv Baker), Judah Prehn (Max Hawthorne), Meredith Garretson (Kate Hawthorne), Gary Farmer (Dan Twelvetrees), Jenna Lamia (Judy Cooper)
